jobs.title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
jobs.description:
À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 220 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Nous prévoyons de recruter 100 nouveaux collaborateurs d’ici 2027. Notre objectif est également d’accélérer la croissance de nos produits, ce qui passe par le renforcement de notre équipe de développement.

Quelques chiffres

  • 220 collaborateurs, dont 45 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).


Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

  • CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

  • Prime de vacances

  • Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

  • Cours de musique sur site

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Radiotech)
jobs.description:
About us

Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently reached an important milestone of 1B+ downloads worldwide, moving closer to our mission of supporting people on their self-improvement journeys.

Headquartered in London, Gismart is a global company with a team of 400+ people across Europe and beyond. We bring together professionals from entertainment, music, and tech backgrounds, combining creativity, product thinking, and strong execution to build apps used by millions of people worldwide.

Our mission is to become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement.

Our values

  • Deliver what matters

  • Respect and support others

  • Initiate and own

  • Voice openly

  • Execute with quality

If you are passionate about mobile products and want to work on apps with real scale, Gismart is the right place to grow, take ownership, and make an impact.


About the project

At Radiotech, we believe music should be accessible to everyone — not only to those who grew up taking lessons.

We are a product team inside the Gismart ecosystem, focused on building and growing music apps across iOS and Android. Our portfolio includes products with millions of installs, rich functionality, and a long history of product development. These are apps that help users not only consume music content, but also play, learn, practice, create, interact, and enjoy the process.

Our goal is to make music feel more approachable, engaging, and human for beginners, hobbyists, and people who want to bring more music into their daily lives.

We are looking for a Product Manager who will not wait for perfectly detailed instructions, but will proactively identify opportunities, take ownership, and move the product forward together with the team.


Responsibilities

  • Own the user journey from the first purchase to the end of the customer lifetime

  • Identify opportunities to improve activation, engagement, retention, monetization, and LTV

  • Work with mobile app functionality, onboarding, paywalls, subscription mechanics, content flows, learning flows, and engagement loops

  • Build and prioritize the product roadmap together with leadership, design, engineering, analytics, marketing, and creative teams

  • Run product discovery through user behavior analysis, market research, competitor analysis, support feedback, and product analytics

  • Write clear product specs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and experiment briefs

  • Launch and analyze A/B tests across onboarding, paywalls, pricing, retention, engagement, and monetization

  • Track product metrics, build conclusions from data, and make ship / iterate / kill decisions

  • Collaborate with UA, PMM, creative, ASO, and growth teams to improve the full funnel from acquisition to long-term retention

  • Proactively identify problems and act without waiting for detailed instructions

Requirements

  • 3+ years of Product Management experience in B2C mobile products

  • Hands-on experience with iOS and/or Android app development processes

  • Strong understanding of subscription or freemium monetization models

  • Proven experience improving product metrics such as conversion, retention, LTV, ARPU, ARPPU, churn, activation, or engagement

  • Experience working with mobile product teams: engineers, designers, QA, analytics, marketing, and product leadership

  • Strong analytical skills: funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention analysis, A/B testing, and experiment interpretation

  • Ability to work with ambiguity, define priorities, and move initiatives forward independently

  • Experience writing clear product requirements and leading initiatives through the full lifecycle: discovery, release, analysis, and iteration

  • English level sufficient for working with international teams and analyzing global market references

Hiring process:

  • Screening

  • Test Task

  • Technical Interview

  • Final interview


Employee Benefits:

  • Remote-First Culture: Our team is diverse and extensive, just like our product portfolio. We provide a flexible working schedule and let you work anywhere in the world, either remotely or in one of our corporate hubs

  • Сoworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide to make sure that everyone has a comfortable and inspiring workspace

  • Free Office Lunches: We want you to stay fueled and focused, so we provide delicious free lunches for everyone working from our hubs. It’s one less thing for you to worry about during a productive workday

  • Public Holidays Policy: Gismart observes public holidays based on the Ukrainian or Polish holiday calendars. Employees working in other locations are entitled to 12 public holidays per year

  • 100% Sick Leave Compensation

  • Mental and Physical Health: To help you stay happy and healthy, Gismart will partially cover your medical insurance, sports activities, therapy costs

  • Personal Equipment Policy: Of course, we’ll provide you with all the equipment you need or cover the maintenance cost for your own tools

  • Personal Learning and Development: We love to see you learn and grow, so Gismart will cover 70% of your professional development courses. We’ll also pay for 100% of corporate English courses

  • Time-Off Policy: Every employee gets 18 working days of paid vacation and 3 personal days per year, with an extra day added for each year at Gismart

  • Corporate Events: We are remote-first, but we love meeting up in person. Whenever possible, we organize corporate events and team-building activities across all Gismart hubs

jobs.title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed.


Your Responsibilities

As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap: Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities.
  • Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments.
  • Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions.
  • Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls.
  • Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability.
  • Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution.
  • Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities.
  • Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
  • Administrators can complete common configuration and management tasks independently without requiring support tickets.
  • Time-to-value for new users is significantly reduced through enhanced onboarding and navigation experiences.
  • A clear, credible multi-year platform roadmap is established and supported by Engineering, Sales, and Leadership stakeholders.


Your Profile

  • 3–5 years of experience as a Product Manager within enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Experience owning and developing foundational product areas such as platform services, administrative experiences, developer portals, or similar infrastructure-related products.
  • Strong understanding of the needs of both IT buyers/administrators and end users.
  • Proven ability to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and drive execution in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Ability to build trust with engineering teams through clear problem definition, structured thinking, and pragmatic decision-making.
  • Experience navigating dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and turning complexity into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Based within a European time zone.


What’s in It for You

  • Join a profitable, growing software company with a strong global presence across Europe, North America, and APAC.
  • Play a key role in shaping the future of a rapidly scaling cloud platform used by thousands of organizations worldwide.
  • Work on high-impact platform experiences that influence how tens of thousands of users interact with Jedox every day.
  • Collaborate with talented international teams in a culture built around #OneTeam, innovation, and impactful results.
  • Enjoy the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to products that deliver real customer value.
  • Help define strategic platform decisions that will shape the Jedox experience for years to come.


Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence

As a tech-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes.
In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Your application is always reviewed by real people.
 
If you would like to learn more about the process, please visit the website of our partner Hi People. Here you will find information about the data protection guidelines as well as the most recent security checks. This gives you complete clarity on how your data is protected and processed. Of course, you can also contact us at any time if you have any questions.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations.

You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works.

You work directly with our product team, our engineers and the founders, and you report to the CTO. This suits someone who enjoys landing things on a date as much as deciding what to build, and who still likes being close to the code.

What you'll do

  • Take every model release live across SAP, the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, on a plan you build with product and engineering.

  • Be the technical counterpart for the partner teams that host TabPFN, from SAP's platform teams to the hyperscaler marketplaces.

  • Shape how TabPFN shows up inside SAP's stack and what the integration engineering team builds first.

  • Bring the open channel decisions to the founders with a recommendation, and stay hands-on: listings, docs, smoke tests, a PR when it is faster than asking.

What we're looking for

  • Two or more years as product manager for a platform or integration surface: a product that ships into partners' platforms, or that other companies build on.

  • You have shipped through gates you did not control, landed multi-team releases on dates, and made a large enterprise's process work for a small, fast team.

  • You started as an engineer and never fully stopped: you read code, logs and scan reports without a translator.

  • You are in Berlin or ready to relocate; Freiburg or New York can work.

What sets you apart

  • You have shipped into an SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft or Oracle ecosystem, or know the cloud marketplaces from the inside.

  • You have deployed machine learning models and know what GPUs cost.

  • You have worked at a startup, and you use AI tools to take real work off your plate.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

A little about us…

Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

Overview

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to help redefine what customer understanding looks like in an AI-native world. You'll own a meaningful product surface end-to-end, drive company-level bets, and operate as a senior voice in how Knit thinks about product strategy, AI craft, and customer value.

You'll ship in two-week cycles alongside one of the strongest engineering benches you'll find at this stage. You'll partner closely with our Director of Product, CTO, CEO, on-staff PhD-level Researchers, and Engineering Leads. This is a force multiplier role in a senior-heavy team, and at this level, we expect your judgment and conviction to shape not just what you ship, but what Knit becomes.

Outcomes

Success in this role is defined by sharper product decisions, stronger execution, and measurable customer and business impact on the surface you own.

  • Customer adoption of shipped work: Usage and adoption rates of new and materially updated capabilities within our target ICP.

  • Product velocity and roadmap reliability: Consistent shipping against outcome-driven commitments, with fewer mid-stream changes and clearer scope on what's in vs. out.

  • Customer and business impact: Expansion revenue, win rate, retention, and customer value creation attributable to your product work.

  • Cross-functional coherence: Engineering, Research, and GTM operating from one shared reality about what matters most, and why.

  • Strategic contribution: Bets you've brought to the table, backed by customer conviction and market insight, that shaped the roadmap beyond your own surface.

Responsibilities | What you will own...

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Own a Meaningful Product Surface End-to-End
    Drive the full lifecycle of your product surface, from discovery to delivery to adoption. Write crisp specs, prioritize ruthlessly, and partner with engineering. Own outcomes, not outputs. At this level, we expect you to define the surface you’re working on in addition to executing against it.

  • Build Direct Customer Intuition
    Spend meaningful, consistent time with customers. Work alongside our PhD-level Researchers, but bring your own developed point of view on how users and buyers at Fortune 1000 brands think, what they need, and where the market is moving.

  • Make AI-Native Product Decisions
    Own the AI layer of your surface: eval strategies, quality loops, failure-mode design, when to trust the model versus defer to humans. This is what separates us from AI-washed research tools, and you'll help us defend and extend that gap.

  • Operate as a Force Multiplier Across R&D and GTM
    Drive clarity on tradeoffs, eliminate mid-stream thrash, and ensure Engineering, Research, and GTM are working from one shared reality about what matters and why. At this level, we expect you to create alignment.

  • Contribute to Company-Level Decisions & Roadmap
    Your impact should reach well beyond what you ship. Bring bets to the betting table backed by real customer conviction, competitive insight, and business judgment. Weigh in on how we plan quarters, how we position against competitors, and how we tell our story to customers. See your bets through with evidence, judgment, and taste.

Required Skills & Experiences

Required:

  • 7+ years as a Product Manager, including meaningful time at a company known for strong product culture — where you learned what a great product org looks like from great leaders, and where you were trusted to operate with real autonomy.

  • 0→1 experience. You've taken a product from zero to meaningful customer usage. Ideally, in an early-stage environment (seed/Series A), where you didn't have a full supporting cast to lean on.

  • AI-native fluency. You've shipped LLM-based features in production. You understand evals, hallucination management, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure-mode design — even if you didn't write the eval code yourself. You use AI tools fluently in your own PM work to draft, prototype, research, and design. You have a real, developed point of view on how the PM role is changing in an AI-native world.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication. Clarity under compression is a baseline expectation. At this level, you're also helping set the standard for how the team communicates.

  • Strong technical fluency. Comfortable driving real conversations with senior engineers about architecture, tradeoffs, and constraints — not just translating between them.

  • Strategic range. You've operated beyond your own surface and influenced roadmap direction, contributed to company-level planning, and shaped how your org thinks about a market. You have opinions that change what gets built, and you back them with evidence.

Nice to Haves

  • Previous founder or first-PM experience at an early-stage startup

  • Experience building tools for researchers or in the market research industry

  • Background operating in a senior IC role in a flat, founder-led environment.

Benefits

jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

 

9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com. But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.

 

These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.

 

The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).

 

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

 

This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

 
 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

  • Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

  • Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

  • Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

  • Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch

  • Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access

 

Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance

 

  • Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect

  • Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up

  • Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls

  • Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows

  • Establish feedback loops between API consumers and domain teams so that usage patterns and client requests improve the underlying data over time

 

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM

 

  • Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad

  • Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities

  • Support the shift to a solution-selling GTM motion: work with Sales and Customer Success on partner selection, POC design, technical onboarding, and commercial structuring for API deals

  • Engage directly with enterprise clients and their technical teams during pilots and integrations; this is a client-facing role, not a back-office one

  • Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs transparently to leadership, engineering, and commercial teams

  • Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

 

What We're Looking For

 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building API products, data platforms, or data distribution products at a B2B company

  • Experience designing APIs for external consumers: you have opinions on schema design, versioning strategies, rate limiting, and what makes developer documentation actually useful

  • Track record of shipping data products where you managed the full lifecycle: from defining what data to expose, through schema design, to commercial packaging and client onboarding

  • Understanding of data infrastructure concepts: data pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, data modelling, and platforms like Snowflake

  • Comfortable with SQL and Python and capable of interrogating data to validate quality, understand usage patterns, and inform product decisions

  • Experience working in a solution-selling or partner-led GTM model: you have been involved in POCs, pilots, or co-development with enterprise clients, not just self-serve product launches

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without a dedicated team: you coordinate across engineering, data, and commercial functions through influence, not authority

  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how enterprise data buyers evaluate providers, and you can shape a product that competes on data quality, coverage, and ease of integration

  • Clear communicator who can translate between technical and commercial audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or how buy-side/sell-side firms consume financial data

  • Experience with Snowflake data sharing, marketplace listings, or similar cloud data distribution mechanisms

  • Experience building entitlements, licensing, or access control systems for data products

  • Understanding of data licensing, redistribution terms, or AI usage policies in the context of enterprise data products

 

Benefits

 

  • Competitive, market-benchmarked salary

  • Pension with 7% company matching

  • Private medical insurance, paid sick leave, income protection, group life assurance

  • Season ticket and cycle-to-work schemes

  • Hybrid flexibility with up to 3 months annual work abroad

  • 25 holiday days plus local public holidays (exchangeable)

  • One-month paid sabbatical after 5 years; enhanced parental leave

  • Professional development budget and regular social events

 

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The Enterprise Business team at Airwallex helps ambitious businesses operate globally by providing the financial infrastructure they need to manage payments, money movement and related financial operations. The Account Management team works strategically to maximise the enterprise customer-Airwallex partnership by building trust, identifying and driving new revenue streams, and ensuring operational success.. You will work alongside , Leadership, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations,Legal, GTM Partnerships, Customer Success, Finance and Revenue Strategy & Operations. The team operates with a high level of ownership and collaboration, managing complex customer needs and contributing directly to enterprise growth.

What you’ll do

As an Account Manager on the Enterprise team, you will manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and help them maximise Airwallex value. You will build trusted relationships across commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, while identifying opportunities to increase adoption, retain customers and expand their use of Airwallex’s products and markets. You will combine strategic account planning with hands-on ownership of upsells, , escalations, onboarding and complex customer initiatives. Working cross-functionally, you will turn customer insights into action and contribute to the growth of Airwallex’s Enterprise Business. This role is a quota-carrying commercial role and is based in London, UK.

Responsibilities:

  • Grow gross profit from existing customer accounts, manage customer operational success, and pursue upsell and expansion opportunities across Airwallex’s product suite.

  • Build and execute strategic account plans, including customer objectives, stakeholder maps, risks, renewal plans and 12 to 18-month growth opportunities.

  • Lead renewals, commercial negotiations, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, using data and customer insight to improve retention and drive Net Revenue Retention.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and run effective business reviews that demonstrate value, address risks and align on future priorities.

  • Coordinate complex customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts, while sharing customer feedback that can inform product, operational and go-to-market improvements.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 5 to 6 years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions.

  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders.

  • Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally.

  • Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products.

  • Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders.

  • A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline.

  • Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Account Management team led by Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global. The team consists of 5 Account Managers, each managing a portfolio of enterprise clients across different EMEA markets. Together, you'll be driving growth and retention for Mirakl's most strategic clients across the region, while regularly exchanging best practices and deal learnings with your counterparts in the AMER account management team.
"As a Senior Account Manager, you will be part of an international team of fun colleagues based in London, Boston, Bordeaux, and Paris. We connect through weekly syncs to share best practices and team wins, regular meet-ups for team-building activities, quarterly business reviews to align everyone on objectives, and a global yearly Sales Kick-off." — Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global
 

2. Your Impact

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise platform accounts, identifying and executing upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Marketplace, Drop Ship, and Catalog Manager products, managing complex sales cycles end-to-end with support from regional and specialist teams
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers at strategic accounts, serving as their go-to partner for marketplace strategy and growth
  • Develop and execute account plans that align client business objectives with Mirakl's roadmap, unlocking expansion opportunities across multiple markets and business units
  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams to deliver a seamless, high-value experience throughout the client lifecycle
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and the competitive landscape to proactively address client challenges and position Mirakl as the definitive platform of choice
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 8+ years in account management, sales roles managing global or strategic accounts in a SaaS or technology environment
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth through upsell and cross-sell motions with complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise clients
  • Experience working in an international context, with the ability to navigate cultural nuances across EMEA markets
Skills:
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to design and execute long-term account plans that create mutual value
  • Strong business acumen to understand complex client business models and connect them to Mirakl's solutions
  • Outstanding communication skills for engaging and influencing senior stakeholders across multi-stakeholder, international environments
  • Financial and analytical rigour to interpret complex contracts and assess revenue implications with confidence
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the drive to proactively build pipeline and unlock new growth opportunities
 

4. Tools Used

  • Salesforce
  • Mirakl internal tools
 

5. Languages

  • English: Fluent — C2 level required
  • French: Fluent — C2 level required

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application, this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition — 30 minutes to explore your background, motivations, and answer any questions about Mirakl
  2. Interview with Stanislas (VP Account Management Global) — Deep dive into your account management approach, commercial track record, and motivation
  3. Values-based interviews — Conversations with colleagues from across the business to assess alignment with Mirakl's core values
  4. Sales pitch exercise — A strategic presentation to demonstrate your commercial thinking and approach to enterprise account management

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

jobs.description:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile and ambitious team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

Join Autonomous Teaming Solutions and build next-generation autonomous robotic systems for demanding real-world environments. You will take end-to-end technical ownership and responsibility of a mission-critical robotics product where perception, system performance, and reliability directly impact operational success. 

As Principal Engineer, you carry overall technical responsibility. You have the final word on architecture, integration and deployment - and you carry the consequences when the system fails. No project manager above you. You decide, you deliver. You work directly with company leadership, not as a career step, but because you are the deepest technically. Your place is still in the team: building, not reporting.

  • You own a complex autonomous system end-to-end - from architecture to field deployment.
  • You build yourself solutions - every day, in the code, next to your team. With us, leading means going first.
  • You are the tiebreaker on technical decisions across all subsystems.
  • You cut whatever does not pay into the next milestone - before you optimize.
  • You test in the field, with measurable and clear pass/fail criteria.


Your profile

  • You are a builder. You have already put things into the world. Systems, products, projects with real users. Not just planned, not conceptualized: built.
  • You have built something of your own before: a company, a product, a project with no one standing behind you. You know what real responsibility feels like. 
  • Deep knowledge in real-time embedded systems, sensor fusion or perception. Proven by systems that run and make a difference. 
  • You have taken something from zero to running hard- and software solutions. Solely responsible, with numbers to show for it.
  • C++ and ROS2 under a latency budget is your terrain.
  • Your first reaction to a new requirement is to ask whether it can be dropped.
  • You have made engineers better by building next to them and coach them.
  • You build in your own time too, because you cannot do otherwise.


What else

  • Citizenship of a NATO member country or close ally.


Why us?

How we work

Clear ownership, everything else is bureaucracy. Every system has exactly one owner with the final word. No V-model, no phase gates, no sign-off meetings. Requirements get challenged, not worked through. Delete first, then simplify, then accelerate - in that order.

Our milestones are binary. Testing happens in the field, not in simulation.


What you get
  • Full technical authority over a system in active deployment.
  • Direct contact with the customer, no layers in between.
  • A team that owns the mission itself.
  • Munich, 5 days on-site. We build together.

No job for you if
  • You need three meetings before a decision gets made.
  • You want a title. What we hand out is the final word and full consequence.
  • A good design matters more to you than a running, functional system.

À propos d’Exegy

Exegy est un leader mondial dans les solutions intelligentes de données de marché, les systèmes de trading avancés et les technologies conçues pour répondre aux besoins de demain. Exegy est un partenaire de confiance pour l’ensemble de l’écosystème financier mondial, notamment les acteurs du buy-side, du sell-side, les places de marché et les entreprises technologiques spécialisées dans les services financiers.

Basée à Saint-Louis, aux États-Unis, avec des bureaux régionaux en Amérique du Nord, au Royaume-Uni/en Europe et en Asie-Pacifique, Exegy dispose d’une présence internationale lui permettant de fournir un support de premier ordre et des services managés à une clientèle composée d’acteurs majeurs des marchés financiers.

Présentation du poste

Au cœur d’une équipe réunissant des compétences en logiciel et en matériel, vous serez un membre clé de l’équipe agile Trading, responsable du développement de solutions de trading autour des produits suivants :

  • nxFeed : un feed handler complet qui simplifie le développement d’applications de données de marché en traitant les flux de données sur FPGA et en les mettant à disposition des applications via une API simple et normalisée

  • nxAccess : un moteur d’exécution complet intégrant un environnement algorithmique FPGA permettant aux utilisateurs de précharger des ordres directement dans le matériel, de recevoir les données de marché, de déclencher et mettre à jour ces ordres, puis de les transmettre à la place de négociation, en combinant la vitesse et les performances du matériel avec la flexibilité du logiciel

Vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe composée d’ingénieurs logiciel et matériel, pilotée par un Engineering Manager en étroite collaboration avec le Product Owner de l’équipe.

Vous interviendrez sur toutes les phases des projets afin de garantir un développement optimisé et performant, répondant aux contraintes liées aux dernières générations de FPGA.

Responsabilités

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

  • À partir des spécifications définies par les architectes et les équipes Product Management, développer et maintenir des briques technologiques en vous appuyant sur nos processus de développement avancés, notamment l’automatisation des tests et la réutilisation du code

  • Participer à l’ensemble du cycle de développement, du codage RTL et de la simulation comportementale jusqu’aux tests automatisés sur plateformes FPGA

  • Développer et maintenir des tests fonctionnels et de performance pour les composants matériels

  • Fournir des retours à l’équipe et identifier les problèmes, risques et éventuelles lacunes au cours des différentes étapes du développement

  • Maintenir et améliorer la documentation des composants matériels parallèlement aux développements réalisés

Profil recherché

  • Diplôme d’ingénieur ou formation équivalente en électronique

  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle

  • Maîtrise complète du cycle de développement FPGA, avec une connaissance approfondie de l’analyse temporelle

  • Capacité à évaluer la qualité et les performances d’une architecture donnée

  • Environnement technique : VHDL, Linux, Python, réseaux, Jenkins, Git

  • Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais

À propos de vous

  • Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement de produits d’accélération matérielle hautement techniques et innovants, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité et aux performances

  • Vous faites preuve de dynamisme et de rigueur et appréciez le travail en équipe dans un environnement technique, collaboratif et exigeant

  • Vous aimez vous investir dans des sujets techniques et contribuer à la résolution de problèmes, que ce soit en équipe ou dans le cadre de l’analyse et du dépannage d’incidents

  • Vous avez un esprit critique, aimez apprendre en continu et prenez plaisir à découvrir de nouvelles technologies et solutions

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Vous intégrerez pleinement une équipe au sein de laquelle vous contribuerez à définir l’orientation du produit

  • Vous aurez l’opportunité de vous challenger, de remettre en question le statu quo et de poursuivre des objectifs ambitieux en matière de qualité, de performance et d’excellence opérationnelle

  • Nous proposons différents avantages afin de favoriser votre équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle ainsi que votre confort au travail

Avantages – Bureau de Paris

  • Prise en charge à 70 % de votre abonnement de transport

  • Forfait mobilités durables

  • Titres-restaurant d’une valeur de 9,86 € par jour, pris en charge à 60 % par Exegy

  • Accord d’intéressement

  • Contribution au plan d’épargne retraite pouvant aller jusqu’à 1 000 € par an

  • Accès à l’application Egym Wellpass offert par Exegy

  • Salle de sport gratuite dans l’immeuble

  • Régime collectif de prévoyance pris en charge à 100 % par Exegy

  • Corbeille de fruits mise à disposition

  • Télétravail jusqu’à 3 jours par semaine

  • Événements d’équipe trimestriels, tels que des Happy Hours et des journées hors site

________________________________________________________________________________

About Exegy

Exegy is a global leader in intelligent market data, advanced trading systems, and future-proof technology. Exegy serves as a trusted partner to the complete ecosystem of the buy-side, sell-side, exchanges, and financial services technology firms around the globe. Headquartered in St. Louis with regional offices in North America, the UK/Europe and Asia Pacific, Exegy has the global footprint to deliver world-class support and managed services to its customer base of elite financial market participants.

Job Summary

At the heart of a mixed software and hardware team you’ll be a key member of the Trading agile team responsible for trading solutions around the following products:

  • nxFeed: A full feature feed handler which streamlines market data application development by processing data feeds on FPGA and making them available to applications via a simple, normalized API

  • nxAccess: A fully featured execution engine with an FPGA algorithm sandbox allowing users to preload orders in hardware, receive market data then trigger & update those orders then send to the trading venue – with the speed and performance of hardware assisted by the flexibility of software

You will work in a team consisting of software & hardware engineers, driven by one Engineering Manager in close relation with the Team Product Owner. You will be involved on all phases of the projects to guarantee an optimized and performing development that responds to the constraints of last generation FPGA development.

Responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Based on specifications written by architects and product management, develop and maintain technology bricks using our advanced workflows (testing automation, code reuse…)

  • Participate on the development cycle from RTL coding, behavioral simulation, up to automatic testing on FPGA platforms

  • Develop & maintain functional & performance tests for hardware components

  • Provide feedback to the team and detect issues, risks & lacks during development steps

  • Maintain and improve documentation for hardware components alongside with any development

Our Ideal Candidate Has:

  • Degree in Electronic Engineering

  • At least 3 years of professional experience

  • Full understanding of the complete FPGA flow with deep knowledge in timing analysis

  • A capacity to judge the quality and performance of a given architecture

  • Technical environment: VHDL, Linux, Python, Networks, Jenkins, Git

  • Professional English and French

More about you:

  • You are passionate about working on very technical and innovative hardware acceleration products with a primary focus on quality and performance.

  • You have a dynamic and rigorous work-ethic with the ability to work in a team-oriented, technical, collaborative environment

  • You like to be involved in technical subjects and contributing to solve problems, be it in a team or managing issues/troubleshooting

  • You are a critical thinker, life-long learner and enjoy discovering new technologies and solutions

What’s in it for you?

  • You’ll be an integral member of a team where you will help define the product direction

  • You’ll have an opportunity to challenge yourself and avoid the status quo with a goal of quality, performance and operational excellence

  • We offer perks that will help you find your work-life balance and professional comfort

Paris Office Perks

  • Transportation subscription supported at 70%

  • Sustainable mobility package

  • Meal vouchers at 9,86 euros per day (60% supported by Exegy)

  • Prevoyance collective (= Death and liability insurance) supported at 100% by Exegy

1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Your mission

As the (Senior / Staff) IT Operations Specialist, you will be the assigned Tech counterpart for the holding/central employees at 1KOMMA5.  This means that every 1KOMMA5 employee in the holding will know their Tech Business Partner by name, and have trust to include them in all technical discussions that improve their productivity. You are accountable for the holdings success.

  1. Tech Support on level 1, 2  and 3 tickets created by holding employees. The goal here is to be familiar with stakeholders for faster, more efficient turnaround.  Tickets are not escalated, but are triaged and discussed to improve technical understanding and develop.  You will also monitor queues for the other markets for urgent out of hours requests, and action them when necessary. Level 1 and 2 tickets may be delegated to working students in the team, with guidance and accountability. 

  2. Tech Projects - This refers to projects imposed by Employee Technology Platform product strategy such as rollout of Chrome OS and tool consolidations for the holding. This also refers to inbound projects imposed by holding teams (e.g. tailor onboarding experience, setup n8n flows).

  3. Tech Consulting - Providing solutions using existing tools first, through enablement sessions. If no solutions exist, working with teams to technically own and benchmark new applications.  There is a particular push to enable AI usage to boost productivity. This means any queries on how to use basic or advanced AI toolings would be directed to this role.


Your profile

  • Minimum of 10+ years of proven professional experience in IT systems, systems engineering or a related field

  • Experience with IT support ticketing best practices, and analysis

  • Proven ability to lead a small and assertive team

  • Proven ability to work both independently, and as part of a team on Technology related projects

  • Profound knowledge of Google Workspace, Office 365, Mobile Device Management (JAMF and InTune) and other SaaS applications (Zoho CRM is a huge plus) surrounding employee productivity, collaboration and security

  • Profound knowledge of AI tooling, specifically relating to employee productivity

  • Understanding on how to utilize scripting to build bespoke functions. Experience with web-front end HTML, CSS,  AppScript, Python and Cursor AI

  • Understanding of the workings of cloud infrastructure and code deployment practices and discipline is a huge plus

  • Generalist knowledge of office infrastructure (e.g. office WLAN)

  • Comprehensive knowledge and proven disciplinary action of domain management

  • Strong people skills, being able to persuade and consult non-technical stakeholders on technical solutions

  • Ability to demonstrate design thinking methodology

  • Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, agile environment and adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a security focus

  • Relevant IT Bachelors or Masters degree - certifications related to MTD, MAM are a plus

  • German and English written and verbal communication

  • Willingness to travel primarily to 1KOMMA5 the other holding locations (Munich & Hamburg)


Benefits

jobs.title: Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​

As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​

Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Leading and developing the Software Production Support team​.

  • Prioritizing urgent production support topics and long-term improvement activities​.

  • Identifying bottlenecks, recurring issues, and process weaknesses in serial production​.

  • Defining robust processes for microcontroller flashing, NVIDIA Orin installation, firmware updates, diagnostics, and recovery workflows​.

  • Driving automation and standardization of software-related production steps​.

  • Ensuring that production tools are reliable, versioned, documented, and maintainable​.

  • Defining requirements for production traceability and digital paper trail documentation​.

  • Coordinating software-related production escalations with Engineering, Quality, and Industrialization​.

  • Ensuring that Operations1 work instructions are technically correct and reflect the real production process​.

  • Monitoring KPIs such as production downtime, flashing success rate, recurring issues, and software-related first-pass yield​.

  • Turning production issues into sustainable process, tooling, or engineering improvements.



What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of experience in embedded systems, production software, manufacturing test, industrialization, or technical production support​.

  • Experience in serial production or manufacturing environments​.

  • Strong understanding of embedded software, firmware flashing, production diagnostics, and system integration​.

  • Experience with Linux-based embedded systems, ideally NVIDIA Jetson / Orin or similar platforms​.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, production tooling, and diagnostic workflows​.

  • Ability to analyze complex issues across software, electronics, tooling, process, and operator interaction​.

  • Experience coordinating or leading technical teams​.

  • Strong communication skills across production operators, engineers, quality teams, and management​.

  • A structured, hands-on mindset with the ability to distinguish one-off production issues from systemic process weaknesses​.

  • Ideally, experience in drones, robotics, aerospace, automotive, defense, or industrial electronics​.

  • Ideally, knowledge of CAN, UART, Ethernet, USB, SWD, JTAG, I2C, SPI, MES, ERP, traceability systems, or Operations1.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

jobs.description:
Du willst mehr sein als ein Byte im Datenmeer? Du möchtest gerne mit Leidenschaft Verantwortung in agilen Teams übernehmen und aktiv mit uns dazu beitragen, die Klimawende voranzutreiben? Dann sollten wir uns unbedingt kennenlernen!

Über uns

Als agiles, grünes Startup und Spezialist für Energiemanagement- und Visualisierungssoftware beteiligen wir uns aktiv an der Gestaltung einer nachhaltigen, klimaneutralen Zukunft. So ist es unsere Mission, mit intuitiver, KI-getriebener Software das Management des Energieverbrauchs so einfach zu machen, dass es für wirklich jeden – egal ob Unternehmen oder Privathaushalt – zu einer Selbstverständlichkeit wird und Energieversorger und Unternehmenskunden wirksam sowohl Energieverbrauch als auch CO2-Fußabdruck reduzieren können. So machen wir mit unseren derzeit 35 talentierten Kolleg:innen die Digitalisierung der Energiebranche zu einer echten Chance.
Seit 2025 sind wir Teil der Hausheld-Gruppe: Gemeinsam mit der Hausheld AG, Solandeo GmbH, Mako365 GmbH bilden wir die erste Full-Service-Plattform für Smart Metering in Deutschland.

Aufgaben

UNSER TECHNOLOGY STACK

  • Kotlin, Spring, Java
  • TypeScript, React, Redux, Recoil

Als Teil eines motivierten und innovativen Teams kümmerst Du Dich um die Zukunft von nachhaltigem Energiemanagement. Ein hervorragendes und nachhaltiges Produkt beginnt mit einer klaren Idee und Vision. Als Software Developer:in bist Du in allen Schritten des Life-cycles Deines Produktes eingebunden und feilst mit unserem Produktmanagement und Architekten an der Strategie der Produktentwicklung. Ein hoher Anspruch, Präzision und kritisches Hinterfragen fangen für Dich schon vor dem Coding an.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Entwickler:innenteam, den Product Ownern und den UX/UI-Designern treibst Du die Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Lösungen (insbesondere Microservices) an
  • Du designst, testest, wartest und verbesserst die Software fortlaufend sowohl selbstständig als auch in Deinem Team
  • Du stehst dem Produktmanagement bei technischen Fragen beratend zur Seite und besprichst Dich mit Ihnen und dem Fachbereich zu fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen und deren Umsetzung
  • Im DevOps Bereich bringst Du Dich zunehmend mitverantwortlich in Architektur, Programmierung und Tests ein
  • Durch Pair Programming, Code Reviews und Prototyping entwickelst Du nicht nur unsere Produkte, sondern auch Dich kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du tauschst Dich regelmäßig im Rahmen von „DevComs“ oder unserem Architecture Board mit unseren agilen und interdisziplinären Teams aus
  • Du schaust über den eigenen Tellerrand hinaus, verwirklichst Deine Ideen in monatlichen GreenDays und hast die Möglichkeit, diese Ideen in die Produktentwicklung einzubringen

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Dein Studium im IT-Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, mit der Du uns überzeugen kannst
  • Darüber hinaus bringst Du bereits erste Erfahrung als Software Developer:in mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld
  • Du hast erste Praxiserfahrungen mit Microservices und Cloudinfrastrukturen
  • Du glänzt mit einem umfangreichen JavaScript-/TypeScript-Wissen, idealerweise im React-Kontext. Alternativ punktest Du mit einem sehr guten Java- oder Kotlin-Know-how und hast Erfahrung mit SpringBoot.
  • Du kennst Dich im Umgang und in der Nutzung von Standardtools insb. im agilen Umfeld wie bspw. JIRA und Confluence zur Steuerung und Dokumentation der Entwicklung aus
  • Als ein kreativer, analytisch denkender Kopf, hast Du Spaß an neuen Technologien und bringst ein gutes Qualitätsbewusstsein mit
  • Du lebst die Startup-Mentalität, bist motiviert und packst gerne Dinge direkt an
  • Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Intensives Coaching und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie Teilnahme an der DevCom und dem Architecture-Board
  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung mit der Möglichkeit, die grüne Gründerszene mitzugestalten
  • Von kununu ausgezeichnete "Top-Company 2025" mit Startup-Atmosphäre und viel Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Wegen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und natürlich die Möglichkeit, aus dem Home Office zu arbeiten
  • Take Your GreenDay! Lass den Alltag hinter Dir und widme einen Tag im Monat ganz Deinen eigenen Ideen
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents (Bouldern, Brett- und Onlinespeielabende, etc.) und täglichen Kicker-Turnieren mit ehrgeizigen Kolleg:innen aka Kicker-Profis
  • Ein Büro voll mit Sprint-Memes und tagesspezifischen Songs (z.B. endet der Freitag immer mit der Playlist "Good Vibes")
  • Wöchentliche, transparente Teammeetings, die mit lustigen Memes vervollständigt werden
  • Unerschöpfliche Kaffee- und Wasservorräte sowie regelmäßig frisches Obst
  • Kulturell, sportlich sowie verkehrstechnisch sehr gut angebundene Lage

Wenn Dich die Herausforderung reizt, uns auf unserer Mission zu begleiten, sende uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf und Dein Anschreiben über das Formular zu.
