jobs.title: Developer Advocate (Database)
Senior Data Scientist (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Mission bei ucm:

Als Technical Product Manager übersetzt du konkrete Probleme von Kunden, flexiblen Mitarbeitenden und internen Teams in Lösungen, die sich im realen Einsatz beweisen und anschließend durch Prozesse, Software oder AI skalieren lassen. Dafür arbeitest du hands-on mit Daten, Prototypen, Automatisierungen und Produktspezifikationen und verbindest Fachbereiche und Engineering vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum produktiven Einsatz.


Du sorgst dafür, dass ucm weniger irrelevante Software baut und erfolgreiche Lösungen schneller im gesamten Unternehmen einsetzt. Software und AI sind dabei skalierende Layer für reale Personalarbeit – kein Selbstzweck.


  • Problem-to-Solution Ownership: Du analysierst operative Probleme, identifizierst die größten Produkthebel und begleitest Lösungen vom Prototyp über die Spezifikation bis zum produktiven Einsatz und zur Erfolgsmessung

  • Hands-on Prototyping & Delivery: Du testest funktionsfähige Prototypen mit echten Nutzern und übergibst Anforderungen als kleine, technisch belastbare und messbare Produkt-Chunks an Engineering

  • AI- & Tool-Enablement: Du arbeitest täglich mit LLMs, AI-Workflows und Low-Code-Tools, automatisierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und machst Lösungen auf neue Märkte und akquirierte Unternehmen übertragbar


Du willst mehr als einen „Job", du willst gestalten, mitwachsen und dich perspektivisch weiterentwickeln. Vielleicht sogar in Richtung Product Lead? Let's talk.


Die Zukunft der Arbeitswelt:

ucm baut das Rückgrat der studentischen Workforce der Zukunft. Unsere Mission: Better jobs for students. Wir verbinden menschliches Potenzial mit KI-gestützter Effizienz und bringen tausende Talente in Jobs mit echter Wirkung.

Wir sind eine AI-First-Company. Wir nutzen KI nicht nur, wir bauen unseren gesamten Kern darauf neu auf. Weg von manueller Steuerung. Hin zu Systemen, die eigenständig funktionieren und skalieren.

Das bedeutet auch: Dinge verändern sich schnell. Prozesse werden neu gedacht. Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen. Du musst bereit sein, dich anzupassen, umzudenken und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn nicht alles vorgegeben ist.

Unser Setup ist klar: Field steht für Umsetzung und Performance vor Ort. Foundry für den Bau von Technologie, Systemen und Wachstum. Frame für Struktur, Steuerung und Skalierbarkeit. Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges System. Du baust es mit und bist verantwortlich dafür, dass es funktioniert.


Deine Aufgaben:

Product Discovery & Analyse


  • Analyse der wichtigsten Customer-, Candidate- und Operations-Prozesse inklusive ihrer System- und Datenflüsse

  • Identifikation und Priorisierung der größten Produkthebel mit Baseline, Ziel und klarem Entscheidungspfad

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are currently looking to add a Product Manager to join our new Munich, Germany office, specifically within the Product Engineering Group. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and managing our technical products, working with our team to define and deliver solutions that support our mission of seamless, out-of-the-box space communication systems. 
 
As a Product Manager at CesiumAstro, you will be at the forefront of managing the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept through to customer integration and support for the European market. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and marketing to develop product strategies that align with our customer needs and business objectives. This role requires a blend of technical knowledge and business acumen, enabling you to drive product decisions and ensure customer success in highly technical environments. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Work closely with senior leadership and engineering teams to define product strategies, ensuring alignment with CesiumAstro’s business objectives and customer needs.  
  • Contribute to the development of product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on market trends, customer feedback, and technological advancements. 
  • Act as a liaison between product engineering, business development/sales, marketing, and customer support teams to deliver products that meet or exceed customer expectations.  
  • Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across teams to drive product development cycles. 
  • Engage directly with customers to understand their technical needs, challenges, and goals. Leverage this insight to inform product decisions and ensure that solutions meet customer expectations. 
  • Oversee the launch of new products and features, working with the marketing team to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction.  
  • Provide technical leadership and customer-facing support as needed to ensure smooth product integrations. 
  • Lead the identification and implementation of continuous improvements for products and processes, ensuring that CesiumAstro’s products remain industry-leading and meet the evolving demands of our customers. 
  • Create and maintain high-quality documentation, including user manuals, application notes, and white papers.  
  • Ensure that customer-facing teams are well-equipped with the knowledge to support product offerings. 

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a relevant technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related discipline. 
  • At least 7 years of experience in the design of communication electronics, technical product development, product management, or application support. 
  • In-depth understanding of RF electronics, communication systems, and associated technologies such as digital systems, embedded software, FPGAs, and power electronics. 
  • Proven experience working with technical customers, developing strong relationships, and translating their needs into actionable product requirements. 
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ or Python. 
  • Exceptional troubleshooting skills and ability to understand, diagnose, and solve complex product issues across hardware and software domains. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience with high-reliability electronics and systems, particularly in the aerospace industry. 
  • Familiarity with small satellite systems and their unique requirements 

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Background in technical sales, marketing, or customer solution development is a plus.
  • Experience in crafting technical solutions for customer proposals, demonstrating an understanding of customer requirements and aligning product capabilities accordingly.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Mission

Airspeed is changing how revenue teams work. Our AI Revenue Orchestration Platform doesn't just analyze conversations — it acts on them. By turning every customer interaction into insight and action, Airspeed Agents help teams close gaps, move faster, and focus on what matters most: selling.

With 100+ SaaS customers and 90%+ adoption among reps, Airspeed is setting a new standard for execution at scale.

The Role

We're hiring a Finance & Operations Lead to build the financial and operational foundations that will support Airspeed's next stage of growth. You'll own our finance engine, company reporting, and core operating systems — helping make Airspeed easier to run and its decisions better.

This is a senior, hands-on role built for a high-performance operator who can move from financial modeling and board reporting to improving workflows and building scalable systems.

You'll report directly to the CEO and work closely with both founders and every functional leader.

This is not a conventional Chief of Staff, strategy-only, or back-office finance role. It's a builder-operator role for someone who takes full ownership of results and uses AI and automation to remove manual work wherever possible.

 

What You'll Own

 

Finance and Reporting:

  • Own the budget, rolling forecast, cash, runway, and scenario planning — giving leadership a clear, trusted view of the company's financial position and future needs.

  • Run a fast and accurate monthly close with our external accounting partners, and produce clear management and board reporting that explains what happened, why it happened, and what requires a decision.

  • Build a trusted view of ARR, bookings, retention, gross margin, burn, headcount, and unit economics, with clear definitions and reconciled data sources.

  • Oversee billing, collections, payroll coordination, expenses, procurement, and vendors, while putting practical controls in place to keep Airspeed ready for fundraising, audit, tax, and diligence.

     

AI, Automation, and Systems:

  • Make Airspeed AI-native in how we operate, not only in what we sell — redesigning recurring workflows with AI agents, automation tools, APIs, and lightweight code.

  • Build dependable operating systems with clean data, exception handling, audit trails, and human approval where needed, and create self-serve workflows that don't depend on you becoming the human router for every request.

  • Measure the impact of automation through speed, accuracy, reporting latency, and manual hours removed, while helping teams use AI safely with sensitive data and high-stakes decisions.

Company Operations:

  • Own the company operating cadence, including planning, KPI reviews, and decision follow-through, ensuring teams have clarity on priorities, ownership, and next steps.

  • Build scalable workflows for purchasing, contracts, onboarding, offboarding, access, and policies, and improve processes that cross team boundaries while keeping ownership clear.

  • Hold external partners and vendors accountable for scope, service, cost, and quality. Step into important gaps when needed, then fix the underlying system so they don't continue to depend on you.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership and the board trust the numbers and the forward forecast.

  • Close, reporting, forecasting, and planning run on a clear schedule with minimal manual chasing.

  • Core SaaS metrics have clear definitions and reconciled sources.

  • High-volume workflows are automated, monitored, and documented.

  • Airspeed can continue to grow without finance and operations headcount increasing with every layer of complexity.

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in finance, business operations, or a combined role at a scaling B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Hands-on ownership of planning, forecasting, management reporting, cash, runway, and board materials.

  • A track record of building operating systems, not simply administering existing processes.

  • Strong data and spreadsheet skills, with the ability to connect information across systems and identify when the underlying data can't be trusted.

  • An AI-native working style, with experience using AI to analyze, draft, reconcile, monitor, automate, and execute work.

  • Sound commercial judgment and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues simply and challenge senior stakeholders when needed.

  • A bias for action: a high-ownership, low-ego operator who is comfortable moving between company-level questions and detailed execution.

  • Comfort working closely across Finance, Sales, Product, Engineering, and other functional teams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in scale-up finance, finance transformation, consulting, or accounting followed by hands-on operating experience.

  • A professional accounting qualification.

  • Experience working with UK and US entities, subscription revenue, fundraising, or finance automation.

  • Experience at an early-stage startup or another lean, high-growth environment.

  • A passion for AI-native products, agent-driven workflows, and building smarter ways of working.

What We Value

  • Customer obsession and a relentless focus on measurable impact.

  • Team players who raise the bar and help scale processes and best practices.

  • Creative problem-solvers who can turn imperfect information into clear plans and results.

  • Operators who step into important gaps, solve the immediate problem, and then build systems that prevent it from recurring.

Why Join

  • Shape how the whole company operates.

  • Build an AI-native finance and operations function from the ground up.

  • Work directly with the founders and influence major company decisions.

  • Join an international SaaS company at a point where strong foundations can create outsized value.

Benefits & Perks

  • Market-competitive total compensation package with equity (stock options).

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Collaborative, inclusive culture that values growth, learning, and excellence.

How to Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. Include a short note about one finance or operations workflow you redesigned or automated, what changed, and the measurable impact.

Airspeed is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and support candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited to own outcomes, influence how an international AI company operates, and help scale a category-defining platform, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Pricing and Monetization
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data-informed growth lever - one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go-to-market, from our 1.5 million-strong community to global Enterprise accounts.

To do so, here's what you'll own:

BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING

  • Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness-to-pay, gross margin, and customer value.

  • Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast.

  • Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings.

DESIGN OUR PRICING & PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE

  • Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add-ons like our startup and charity plans.

  • Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption-based models as our product and cost-to-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect.

  • Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features.

DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS

  • Lead cross-functional pricing decision-making and secure buy-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data.

  • Own the rollout of major pricing changes end-to-end, from decision to launch to measured impact.

  • Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage-based billing decisions.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 📈 Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS: You have 6+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat-based to usage-based, or a platform repricing.

  • ⚡ Hands-on with modern pricing models: You've personally designed and rolled out consumption-based, outcome-based, or AI-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR.

  • 🔀 Both self-serve and Enterprise motions: You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) and Enterprise, sales-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough.

  • 🧮 Deep analytical rigour: You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost-to-serve, gross margin, willingness-to-pay, and elasticity.

  • 🔌 Billing fluency, technical and operational: You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true-ups, and disputes.

  • 🛠️ Empathy for technical users and buyers: You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience.

  • 🧩 Frameworks over bottlenecks: You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you.

  • 🤝 Cross-functional influence: You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions.

  • 🧭 Motivated by scope, not headcount: You're energised by owning a global, high-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management.

Nice-to-have

  • 🎓 Formal pricing training: You've been trained at Simon-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you.

  • 🧑‍💻 Developer tools experience: You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams.

  • 🌍 Open source or freemium background: You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust.

Why join us?

At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap - it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5.2bn company monetises across community, self-serve, and Enterprise, in 100+ countries and across both cloud and self-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now - and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. 

DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. 

Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. 

Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? 


Deine Rolle 
 

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Footwear Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du siehst einen Trend und denkst nicht: „Das könnten wir auch machen.“

Du denkst drei Schritte weiter.

Was kommt danach? Was passt zu unserer Kundin? Und wie machen wir daraus etwas, das eindeutig Pammys ist?

Du hast ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Schuhe, Fashion, Farben, Materialien und Silhouetten und gleichzeitig genug kommerzielles Verständnis, um zu wissen, dass ein großartiges Produkt nicht nur auf einem Moodboard funktionieren muss.

Es muss gekauft werden.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende daran, aus Pammys eine internationale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Mit unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase bauen wir unser Produktportfolio deutlich aus und entwickeln Pammys von einzelnen erfolgreichen Produkten zu einer starken internationalen Footwear Brand.

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Footwear Designer (m/w/d), der unsere zukünftigen Kollektionen und Produkte maßgeblich mitgestaltet.

Du bekommst keine fertigen Ideen zum Ausarbeiten.

Wir erwarten, dass die besten Ideen von dir kommen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung neuer Footwear-Konzepte, Modelle und Kollektionen von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Design
  • Übersetzung von Fashion-, Footwear-, Consumer- und Cultural Trends in kommerziell relevante Produkte für Pammys
  • Entwicklung von Silhouetten, Colorways, Materialien, Details, Sohlen und Designkonzepten
  • Aufbau von saisonalen Creative Directions, Moodboards, Color & Material Stories und Collection Concepts
  • Kontinuierliche Analyse internationaler Runways, Brands, Retailer, Social Media und Streetstyle-Trends

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Development, Technical Development, Sourcing und Merchandising vom ersten Konzept bis zur Produktionsreife
  • Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung von Samples mit Fokus auf Design, Proportionen, Materialien, Farben und Details
  • Nutzung von Sales Data, Customer Feedback und Marktinformationen, um bestehende Bestseller weiterzuentwickeln und neue Produktchancen zu identifizieren
  • Regelmäßige internationale Trend-, Messe-, Markt- und Lieferantenreisen, um Entwicklungen früh zu erkennen und Produkte direkt vor Ort weiterzuentwickeln


Dein Profil

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Footwear Designer oder Senior Footwear Designer, idealerweise bei einer relevanten Fashion-, Footwear-, Lifestyle- oder Consumer Brand
  • Starkes Portfolio mit nachweislich realisierten und kommerziell erfolgreichen Footwear-Produkten
  • Herausragendes Gespür für Silhouetten, Proportionen, Farben, Materialien und Details
  • Tiefes Verständnis aktueller Footwear-, Fashion-, Lifestyle- und Consumer-Trends
  • Fähigkeit, Trends nicht einfach zu kopieren, sondern daraus eine eigenständige und kommerziell relevante Designsprache zu entwickeln
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung vollständiger Kollektionen, saisonaler Konzepte und Produktfamilien
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis des gesamten Footwear-Entwicklungsprozesses von Design über Sampling bis zur Produktion
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop und relevanten Design-Tools, Erfahrung mit 3D- und AI-basierten Design-Workflows ist ein großes Plus
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, Kreativität, Customer Needs und Verkaufspotenzial miteinander zu verbinden
  • Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Product Development, Fabriken und internationalen Produktionspartnern
  • Sehr hohe visuelle Standards und gleichzeitig Geschwindigkeit in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung
  • Ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und eine klare kreative Meinung
  • Hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft für Trend Research, Messen, Lieferanten und Produktionspartner
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Product Impact: Deine Designs werden zu Produkten, die von einer internationalen Customer Base getragen werden
  • Creative Ownership: Gestalte die zukünftige Design DNA und Produktsprache von Pammys maßgeblich mit
  • Scale: Entwickle Kollektionen für eine Footwear Brand mit über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden

jobs.title: Lead Deployment Architect
Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
jobs.description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
  • Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.


Das bekommst Du

  • Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
  • Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.
  • AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. 
  • Kurze Wege, keine Entscheidungsgremien Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team, das sie später auch betreibt. Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in einem Backlog-Archiv. 
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard.
  • Du entscheidest ob Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl.
  • Urlaub, der mit dir wächst: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub + dazu Weihnachten und Silvester frei - und mit steigender Betriebszugehörigkeit kommen weitere Tage dazu. 
  • Jobticket oder JobRad - wir machen deinen Weg ins Office einfacher und grüner.
  • Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt.
  • Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt.


Das sind WIR

Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Mit avenit und Vusyon vereinen wir zwei starke Kräfte - langjährige führende Digitalexpertise und modernste KI-Technologie - zu einem Partner für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Zukunft nicht nur denkt, sondern gestaltet.

Unser innovatives KI-Team in der Vusyon GmbH sucht Verstärkung, um unsere KI-Plattform für den Mittelstand weiter zu entwickeln. Neugierig, was uns dort besonders macht? Mehr erfährst du hier: https://vusyon.ai/

jobs.title: Head of AI Engineering (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your mission

Own and evolve our AI engineering function — transforming a 15–20 person ML team from research-heavy to a high-throughput, production-grade organization. You’ll partner with the CTO on strategy, build the platform that unifies LLM access, RAG, and backend services, and ship reliable, scalable AI features that change how banks work.
 
Key responsibilities 

  • Team leadership and org build
    • Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team; set the technical bar, operating rhythms, and code/research review practices
    • Organize sub-teams (e.g., Core Modeling, AI Platform/Infra, Integrations) with clear ownership, SLOs, andon-call
    • Manage roadmap, capacity planning, and delivery across parallel initiatives
  • Architecture and platform
    • Own the LLM gateway: unified APIs and proxy layers for multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Gemini, Bedrock), with rate limits, fallbacks, and cost tracking
    • Build high-performance RAG pipelines (ingestion, embeddings, vector stores, caching) with robust observability and safety guardrails
    • Partner with Java/NestJSteams to define clean async contracts, schemas, and eventing patterns; drive low-latency, scalable inference
  • Model lifecycle and operations
    • Lead end-to-end model and prompt lifecycle: data curation, training/fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, rollback
    • Establish LLMOps/MLOps: model/prompt registries, CI/CD, canary/A/B tests, offline/online evals, drift and cost monitoring
    • Optimizeinference throughput and cost (autoscaling, batching, quantization/distillation, caching)
  • Strategy and collaboration
    • Translate company goals into an AI/ML roadmap with measurable outcomes; balance exploration with reliability and cost
    • Own build-vs-buy/vendor strategy for models, infrastructure, and data services; manage budgets and SLAs
  • Governance and security
    • Implement data privacy, security, and compliance practices (RBAC, secrets, auditability); track prompt/model lineage and reproducibility
    • Define incident response, runbooks, and postmortems for AI features


Your profile

  • 5+ years as a backend engineer and 4+ years leading AI/ML engineering in production (10+ years total experience ideal)
  • Deep architecture expertise in Java (JVM) and/or Node.js (NestJS), distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and messaging/streaming
  • Hands-on with LLM stacks: orchestration (e.g.,LangChain/LlamaIndexor custom), vector DBs (Pinecone,Qdrant, FAISS), cloud AI (e.g., AWS Bedrock)
  • Proven operation of systems at scale (millions of daily API calls) with strong SLOs, observability, and incident management
  • MLOpsfoundations: model registries, experiment tracking, CI/CD, Kubernetes,IaC(e.g., Terraform), security best practices
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management; strong product sense focused on shipping user-facing feature 
  • Fluent German and English for daily team collaboration, stakeholder management, and technical documentation
Nice to have 
  • Experience with GPU/accelerator serving and optimization (vLLM, TGI, Triton, ONNX Runtime)
  • Cost optimization for LLM workloads (token budgets, dynamic routing, caching)
  • Evaluation and safety/red-teaming for generative systems; startup/high-growth experience
Impact metrics 
  • Platform: adoption of a unified LLM gateway; standardized observability and cost reporting
  • Delivery: 2–3 user-facing AI features shipped with clear SLOs and measurable impact
  • Reliability/cost: reduced average latency and cost per request; autoscaling and caching in place
  • Org: sub-team structureestablished; improved code quality and on-time delivery; targeted hiring completed
Our stack  
  • Backend: Java (JVM), Node.js (NestJS); event-driven microservices; API gateways/proxies
  • AI platform: Python,PyTorch, LLM orchestration, prompt pipelines/registry; vector DBs (Pinecone,Qdrant); RAG services
  • Infra/DevOps: AWS (incl. Bedrock), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana)


Why us

  • Because we value talent more than hierarchy.
  • Because at neoshare, responsibility isn't delegated - it's owned.
  • Because we use modern AI and technology as a lever for exceptional results.
  • Because we develop people who want to learn, grow, and deliver.
  • Because performance, quality, and impact belong together for us.
  • Because we are working together towards building a European tech champion.


What You Can Expect

  • Performance-driven, above-average compensation that rewards outstanding commitment.
  • High-end offices designed to support collaboration, wellbeing, and peak performance - including great health and fitness benefits.
  • Legendary team events where we celebrate our wins together and strengthen team spirit.
  • State-of-the-art AI tools, first-class equipment, and an environment that fosters ownership and personal growth.
  • Concentration of top talent, fast decision-making, and the chance to make a real impact early on.

Candidates must have the right to work in the EU; visa sponsorship is not provided for this role.

jobs.title: Staff Offensive Security Engineer
Principal, CEO Office
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The CEO Office

The CEO Office works with senior leaders across Checkout.com on high-priority strategic and operational problems. The team turns important questions into clear decisions, coordinated execution and measurable business outcomes.

The role

This is a manager-level individual-contributor role for a hands-on operator. You will own defined, high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end—from framing problems and aligning stakeholders to implementing solutions and delivering measurable outcomes.

Working closely with the Head of the CEO Office, you will combine structured problem-solving with hands-on execution. You will translate priorities into coordinated action, strengthen how teams operate and drive initiatives through to impact.

This is neither a traditional PMO nor a presentation-led strategy role, and it is not an executive-level position. Success requires sound judgement, analytical rigour, clear communication, operational follow-through and the ability to influence effectively without formal authority.

How You'll Make an Impact (Role overview)

  • Support the CEO and Head of the CEO Office on critical cross-functional initiatives by helping coordinate day-to-day delivery, stakeholder collaboration and progress towards measurable outcomes.

  • Help investigate complex, ambiguous problems by clarifying the problem, developing practical solutions and supporting the implementation of durable processes or systems.

  • Support departments in scaling by contributing to organisation design, objectives and KPI setting, and the development of robust operating processes.

  • Assist leadership in navigating ambiguity by surfacing insights, decisions and risks, coordinating follow-through and supporting alignment across teams, particularly where there is no natural owner.

  • Projects may include organisational model design, international expansion strategy, scaling new business lines, strategic planning and goal setting, go-to-market execution, regulatory, data and financial infrastructure initiatives, and supporting board and shareholder reporting.

What We're Looking For (Background and core competencies)

  • Relevant background and impact: Experience in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.Relevant backgrounds include consulting, high-growth technology, investing, investment banking, strategic finance or entrepreneurial operations. Payments or fintech exposure and international experience are advantages.

  • Problem-solving and analytical rigour: Use first-principles thinking, data and judgement to structure ambiguous problems, identify key measures and move between strategic questions and operational detail. Advanced SQL or hands-on data analysis is a plus.

  • Building and execution: Turn analysis into practical plans, KPIs, processes, tools or systems that create durable value. Experience building low-code/no-code or AI automations that others continue to use is a plus.

  • Ownership and impact: Personally own cross-functional work and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Influence and collaboration: Build trust, navigate trade-offs and make progress across functions without formal authority, with a low-ego and collaborative approach.

  • Learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset: Learn quickly, respond well to feedback, adapt to changing priorities and show evidence of creating, launching or materially improving something from scratch. Founding or entrepreneurial experience is valued but not required.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
Finance & Reconciliation Analyst / Safeguarding
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst to join our Safeguarding function at Pleo.

In this role, you'll be at the heart of how we meet our safeguarding obligations under FCA rules. You'll perform daily and periodic reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions, contribute to process improvement initiatives, and support our external audit activity. You'll also help produce the management information that feeds into our governance oversight. If you're genuinely curious about payments and financial infrastructure, good with data, and keen to learn and improve as you go, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Head of Safeguarding and work closely with teams across Finance Operations, Compliance, and Product.

Our Finance function is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safeguarding and financial control. You'll also have the opportunity to partner with colleagues across our operations, audit, and leadership teams to help drive strong governance and regulatory compliance.

What you'll be doing

As a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst in Safeguarding, you will:

  • Perform and support the review of daily and periodic safeguarding reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions

  • Monitor reconciliation outputs and carry out post-review checks and manual follow-up activity

  • Investigate breaks and exceptions, escalating where needed and tracking issues through to resolution

  • Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation and clear audit trails

  • Help collate and prepare management information on reconciliations and exceptions for governance forums including the Safeguarding Committee

  • Work with data in spreadsheets and internal systems to extract, check and present information clearly

  • Spot patterns in exceptions or recurring issues and flag them to the team

  • Contribute to reconciliations-related projects, including system changes, tooling improvements and process redesign

  • Flag inefficiencies or recurring control weaknesses and bring forward practical ideas to address them

  • Support the development and automation of reporting processes over time

  • Help prepare and organise documentation, evidence packs and reconciliation outputs for external audit

  • Respond to auditor queries and requests in a timely and accurate manner

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2+ years of experience in a reconciliations, payments, finance operations or similar role

  • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) and a keen interest to develop further

  • A methodical and accurate approach — you take care with the details and notice when something doesn't look right

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain what you've found clearly to colleagues and, where needed, to external auditors

  • Genuine interest in how financial services and payments regulation works in practice

  • A passion for solving problems in practical and innovative ways

  • Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You're genuinely curious about fintech and how payments infrastructure actually works

  • You enjoy working with data and understanding systems, not just using them

  • You're excited by the responsibility of maintaining financial controls and regulatory compliance

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes and ways of working

  • You bring a self-starter attitude — you don't wait to be told what to do next

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You struggle working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

  • You do not enjoy detailed analytical or investigative work

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with colleagues across teams

  • You're not interested in the practical application of financial regulation

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Pleo's safeguarding obligations under FCA rules, including the CASS and DFSA safeguarding requirements. Learn how our reconciliation processes work across all our systems and develop expertise in carrying out and reviewing reconciliations

  • Collaborate with colleagues to help improve and streamline our reconciliation and reporting processes

  • Grow your skills in data handling, financial analysis, and audit preparation

  • Take on new challenges as you build confidence and the company continues to scale

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into process improvement leadership, or acquiring new skills in areas you identify for growth.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background

  • Hiring Manager: A 45-minute chat with our Head of Safeguarding & Reconciliation

  • Pleo challenge: A 60-minute chat with peers and/or stakeholders to check how you would think and act in the role. Expect some real life examples as well as on the spot challenges

  • Final Interview: A 30-minute final chat with one of our senior stakeholders

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a significant number of applications but only a fraction were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn't make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.

  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment  — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.
  • Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).
