jobs.title: Engineering Manager (m/f/d)
(Senior) People Operations Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.


Your Role

bunch is around 155 people across Berlin, London, and Amsterdam, and Luxembourg, on the way to roughly 200 in 2027. That means four legal entities, four payroll providers, different sets of people systems to reconcile, different compliance environments.

Right now our People operations run 50% on effort. We want them to run mostly on systems. We also want our people data to be trustworthy enough that headcount, attrition, and hiring numbers are the same in every room they're quoted in.

This person will own the operational and data backbone that the rest of the People function depends on.

You will:

  • Take full, end-to-end ownership of core People Operations topics — including onboarding, offboarding, contracts, leaves, absence, payroll, immigration cases and documentation — from decision-making through execution.

  • Design, build, and roll out automated, AI-supported workflows and integrations across our tools — including Personio (HRIS) and Notion — to eliminate manual work and connect our systems.

  • Coordinate monthly payroll across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands and in the near future, Luxembourg, with our external providers. You own data accuracy, deadlines and the provider relationships — the providers own the processing.

  • Maintain the compliance calendar and the documentation behind it, working with external counsel where local employment law is involved.

  • Manage and support our full workforce across multiple contract types and locations, ensuring correct setup, documentation, and ongoing administration for each.

  • Be the first line for employee questions on policy, contracts, leave and benefits — and steadily reduce that volume by making the answers self-serve in our handbook.

  • Own the documentation and record-keeping behind employee relations cases: case files, timelines, correspondence.

  • Proactively identify gaps and inefficiencies in our People Operations processes, and independently drive improvement projects from idea through implementation.

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date HRIS data as a reliable single source of truth, and support strategic reporting and people analytics to inform business decisions.

About You

  • 4+ years of experience in People Operations or HR administration, ideally in a fast-paced, international or scaling startup environment

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of operational topics

  • Knowledge of German employment law and compliance requirements; UK or Luxembourgish employment law is a plus

  • Experience supporting a varied, international workforce across different contract types, legal entities, locations and working models

  • Payroll coordination experience with external providers in at least one European country, owning accurate inputs, deadlines and provider relationships

  • A strong track record in automation, including designing and implementing workflow integrations or AI-supported solutions in an HR or operations context

  • Hands-on ownership of an HRIS — Personio ideally, or a comparable system you have configured and maintained — plus confidence connecting tools such as Notion to build efficient workflows

  • Strong data literacy: you can build reliable reports, spot inconsistencies and investigate until the numbers are trustworthy

  • Excellent judgment and communication skills, with the ability to act as a trusted advisor to employees, managers and senior stakeholders

  • Fluency in English; German is a plus.

What success looks like

  • Own it: You take responsibility for outcomes, manage competing priorities and keep your work, decisions and commitments clearly documented and on track

  • Aim for impact: You look beyond the immediate request, prioritise what moves the needle and remove recurring work through better processes, automation and self-service

  • Empower others: You are professional yet personable — a trusted, approachable partner who communicates clearly, protects confidentiality and holds boundaries with care

  • Always be curious: You question inefficient ways of working, think through edge cases and keep learning across systems, data and changing compliance requirements

  • Enjoy the ride: You bring warmth, resilience and positive energy, helping people feel supported even when the topic is stressful or sensitive

  • Detail-obsessed, in a good way: You get genuine satisfaction from accurate records, correctly filed documents and carefully tracked deadlines, because you know that is where compliance and trust are won or lost.

Workplace & benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus two company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid work with three days per week in the office

  • Up to six remote calendar weeks per year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 150+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Interview process

  1. Intro call (30 min) — Senior People Business Partner. Your background, the role, mutual fit

  2. Hiring manager interview (60 min) — Joana, People Lead. Scope, experience, how you work

  3. Practical Case (60 min) — a real problem from our stack, sent to you in advance and discussed together.

  4. Final Round: Stakeholder conversations (2x30 min) — Finance & Legal and Co-Founder

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.


____

STRATEGIC CLIENT DIRECTOR (m/w/d)
Berlin, Deutschland · Hybrid · Vollzeit

ÜBER UNS

The Global Talent Co. verbindet Talente mit führenden, innovativen Technologieunternehmen weltweit. Wir bieten sichere Anstellungen, wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung, klare Karriereperspektiven und Zugang zu einer Community von über 25.000 Gleichgesinnten.

ÜBER DAS UNTERNEHMEN

Sie steigen bei einem schnell wachsenden, gründergeführten europäischen B2B-Unternehmen ein, dem einige der bekanntesten Marken aus Retail, Hospitality, Tech und Luxury in Deutschland und darüber hinaus vertrauen. Seit der Gründung 2014 wurde ein Premiumprodukt mit einem loyalen AAA-Kundenstamm aufgebaut, und das Unternehmen expandiert nun aggressiv mit Enterprise-Partnerschaften in ganz Europa.

Dieses Unternehmen muss sich nicht mehr beweisen. Das Produkt verkauft sich bei den richtigen Ansprechpartnern selbst. Gesucht wird die richtige Person, die es genau diesen Ansprechpartnern vorstellt.

Dies ist eine echte Hunter-Rolle: senior, strategisch und mit hoher Eigenverantwortung. Sie übernehmen die Neukundengewinnung großer Markenkunden von der Identifikation bis zum Abschluss. Es gibt keine warme Pipeline, die übergeben wird. Sie bauen sie selbst auf, bearbeiten sie selbst und schließen selbst ab, unterstützt von einem erfahrenen internen Team, das nach Vertragsabschluss die gesamte Projektumsetzung übernimmt.

Wer Erfahrung in einer Marketing- oder Kreativagentur gesammelt und Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf Markenseite aufgebaut hat, findet hier die passende Rolle.

IHRE AUFGABEN

  • Identifikation, Ansprache und Abschluss komplexer, hochwertiger Signage-Partnerschaften mit führenden europäischen Marken

  • Aufbau und Verantwortung von Beziehungen auf C-Level und Senior-Entscheider-Ebene, nicht nur deren Pflege

  • Kundenbesuche gezielt und strategisch planen, nicht routinemäßig

IHR PROFIL

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im strategischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Key Account Management mit nachweisbarem Erfolg beim Abschluss komplexer, hochwertiger Deals

  • Sicher und überzeugend auf C-Level: Sie führen ein Verkaufsgespräch mit CMO oder CEO souverän

  • Ein echter Hunter, der sich Türen selbst öffnet, statt darauf zu warten

  • Kommerziell versiert: Verständnis für Margen, Vertragsstrukturen und komplexe Beschaffungsprozesse

  • Erfahrung in einer Marketing-, Kreativ- oder Markenagentur ist ein starkes Plus, inklusive Netzwerk und Branchensprache

  • Strukturiert und CRM-diszipliniert: Pipeline-Management ist selbstverständlich, keine Pflichtübung

  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch

  • Die Möglichkeit, ein Produkt zu vertreten, das die größten Marken Europas wirklich schätzen

jobs.title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements.

  • Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

  • Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

Communications & Data Handling

  • Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts.

  • Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

  • Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints.

  • Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration & Interface Management

  • Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

  • Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

  • Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification & Validation

  • Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

  • Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

  • Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

  • Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

  • Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

  • Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

  • Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

  • Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.

  • +7 years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Electronic and embedded system architectures

    • Communication and data handling principles

    • System integration and interface management

  • Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development.

  • Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems.

  • Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS).

  • Experience with HIL testing, simulation environments, or digital engineering tools.

  • Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.

  • Experience working in international or multi-stakeholder engineering teams.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.

Your impact at gridX

As a Junior Software Engineer on the Platforms Team, you’ll play a key role in bridging the gap between external cloud ecosystems and the gridX platform. As part of the Cloud Connector team, your work is the bridge between the gridX platform and the outside world. You will build and maintain the backend services that allow us to seamlessly integrate with external energy providers. Your code will turn complex, varied external APIs into standardized, reliable connections that the rest of our engineering organization relies on. By developing robust APIs and smart integration tools, you empower gridX to onboard new cloud assets faster, making energy management seamless for our customers and platform partners alike.
Are you ready to #makeamark, #getshitdone, and build the future of energy? Apply now and join our mission!

Please note: We only accept applications from candidates who are currently located in Germany.


How you can contribute to gridX

What you’ll work on

  • Integrations with partners: Your primary focus is seamlessly integrating various cloud providers into our ecosystem. This involves implementing and maintaining Go services that abstract away provider-specific edge cases, allowing us to reliably gather measurements and send control commands. You'll work closely with API specs, frequently leveraging AI coding tools to accelerate your implementation and review cycles.
  • Fast scaling: You’ll engineer solutions for a fast-scaling platform handling around 20.000 cloud-connected assets. With our managed fleet growing over 80%  the past 6 months, you’ll play a critical role in designing architecture that handles heavy telemetry and real-time control at scale.
  • Cross-team Collaboration: The Cloud Connector is the critical bridge connecting physical devices to gridX’s wider platform architecture. You'll build the cloud integrations that link assets to our platform, ingest asset data for various services, and route real-time execution commands back to the assets via cloud providers.

We use AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows extensively, from code generation and review to spec analysis and test creation. You'll be expected to leverage these tools effectively and help actively shape our evolving engineering culture.

Day-to-day, that means

  • Implementing new cloud integrations based on API documentation, OAuth specifications, and webhook contracts.
  • Evolving the integration framework, refactoring event-processing chains, migrating data stores, and shaping the abstractions that make future integrations simpler.
  • Debugging distributed pipeline failures using structured logs, distributed traces, and metrics, across OAuth flows, webhook processing, and event delivery.
  • Writing tests that cover provider API contracts, webhook edge cases, command delivery reliability, and distributed failure modes.
  • Contributing to API specifications (TypeSpec/OpenAPI, protobuf/gRPC) that connects to downstream gridX services and external partners.
  • Collaborating with cloud API teams, Product Owners, Platform Engineers, and Energy Domain Experts.


This is how you and your application stand out

What matters beyond code

  • Pragmatism over perfection: You ship working software, iterate, and don't gold-plate.
  • Product thinking: You care about what your code enables for users and partners, not just the code itself.
  • Interest in the domain: You find renewable energy hardware fascinating if you're curious. You don't need prior energy sector expertise, but genuine interest is important.
  • End-to-End ownership: You follow through from “it compiles” to “it runs in production.” You embrace a “you build it, you run it” mindset, deploying, operating, and monitoring your own services on our Kubernetes cluster using automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Tech Stack: You work with Go • Linux • Docker • Kubernetes • gRPC • Protocol Buffers • PostgreSQL • AWS • CI/CD • Nix

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with electrical engineering concepts (power, current, phases)
  • Familiarity with running Go backend workloads in Kubernetes
  • Experience with IoT or embedded-adjacent systems
  • Contributions to open-source Go projects
  • German language skills (team is mixed EN/DE, English is working language)


Why gridX

We believe great work happens when people have the freedom, support, and flexibility to do their best work. That’s why we offer a benefits package designed to support your work, wellbeing, development, and life outside of work.

  • Flexible & mobile working: Work remotely for up to 70 days per year from anywhere in the EU and selected countries outside the EU.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 days of vacation plus an additional half day off on December 24 and December 31.
  • Health & sports: Get a €30 monthly allowance for Urban Sports Club or EGYM Wellpass, plus access to company health management and mental health support.
  • Personal development: Benefit from cross-functional coaching, e-learning platforms, and an annual development budget of €1,500.
  • Employee discounts: Enjoy exclusive offers and discounts through gridX Corporate Benefits.
  • JobRad: Lease a bike through our JobRad program and combine sustainable commuting with an active lifestyle.
  • Company pension plan: Receive a fair monthly employer contribution to your company pension plan.
  • Mobility support: Get a €30 monthly subsidy for your public transportation ticket.
  • Modern workplace: Work from our offices in the heart of Aachen or Munich with modern IT equipment of your choice.
  • Team events & culture: Experience the gridX culture through regular team events, plus an additional €100 annual budget for department events.
  • Birthday donation: We donate €20 to a charity of your choice on your birthday.
  • Sabbatical option: Take an extended break for personal projects, travel, further education, or simply to recharge.


*Please note that our benefits may differ for employees working 100% remotely.

jobs.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

 

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

Our Benefits (US Employees Only)

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

Compensation: $25 – $35 per hour

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place

Your Team and Role

Working on the Marketing & Communications Functional Team, you'll drive profitable acquisition of paid subscribers and work on related projects that aim to help millions of people take back control of their personal information.

Recent projects include:

  • Supporting strategy and planning for new paid advertising initiatives to profitably scale subscriptions

  • Launching new ad channel tests and measuring incremental lift

  • Executing in-market tests for new creative and messaging following a brand refresh

As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll manage high priority marketing campaigns, including planning, hands-on execution, testing, optimization, and analysis to optimize spend and drive profitable paid subscriber growth. This role will help create and execute a new marketing program for paid subscriptions. You'll deliver results from new channel testing, creative testing, and by optimizing paid subscriber conversion. The right person is excited to prove that paid marketing growth and privacy-respecting advertising practices aren’t at odds — they’re our edge. You know how to use aggregate measurement, experimentation, and strong judgment rather than user-level targeting and tracking.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in digital advertising roles, with 2+ years of experience in paid acquisition for freemium consumer subscription apps preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience with both strategic planning and execution in digital marketing platforms (app store ads, paid social, mobile app networks) to profitably scale app subscriber growth.

  • Hands-on expertise standing up paid subscription programs from scratch, with a track record of scaling subscriber growth profitably against LTV and payback — not just acquisition costs.

  • Experience driving subscription growth within an established, high-traffic product where subscription revenue is a secondary — not primary — revenue model, preferred.

  • Track record partnering with Engineering and Product to build and optimize landing pages, funnels, product experiences, and instrumentation.

  • Ability to execute highly complex and ambiguous projects, working across business strategy and marketing tactics.

  • Advanced analytical and measurement abilities, including app economics (payback, LTV), incrementality/lift testing, modeling, and data analysis.

  • Excellent communication skills — you can clearly articulate recommendations and rationale, whether verbal or written.

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

jobs.title: Research Scientist/Engineer (Agentic Systems)
jobs.description:
TLDR: We're looking for a research scientist to build autonomous, large-scale environments that push LLM agents (single and multi-agent) to failure, and study how they actually break.

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over 100M+ API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

About the team

White Circle's fundamental research team works on the science of how AI systems fail: where agents break, why misalignment and unsafe behaviours emerge, and how to catch them before they reach the real world. We build the evals, benchmarks, environments, and tooling that empirically study the most pressing AI safety concerns — some of which become the guardrails shipped in our products, and some of which become public writeups.

You will

  • Build adversarial environments for agents: complex, uncertain settings that sit on the boundary of agent capability and alignment, where failure is informative rather than trivial.

  • Build realistic multi-agent environments and instrument them so emergent breakdowns are observable — failures that arise from the agents themselves, not ones scripted from the outside.

  • Run experiments end to end, against external APIs and our own models, orchestrating many agents in parallel.

  • Catalogue concrete agent failure modes and build the tooling to surface them at scale.

  • Turn findings into internal models of agent behaviour and into public writeups.

You’ll fit right in if you:

  • Have built at least one non-trivial agent environment or automated research pipeline that ran end to end (single- or multi-agent), and can talk through what broke and why.

  • Strong software and AI engineering. Can independently orchestrate many agents and containers in parallel without that orchestration being the bottleneck.

  • A track record of empirical research in agents, red-teaming, or post-training where you defined the question, ran it, and drew a defensible conclusion.

  • A fast empirical iterator who is comfortable defining the question when there's no playbook: can take a fuzzy concern ("do these agents collude under pressure?") and turn it into a concrete, falsifiable experiment.

  • An AI power-user — fluent with frontier models and coding agents in your daily work.

A big plus:

  • Published research at A* venues on automated red-teaming, agentic environments, or post-training.

  • Experience building monitoring for model failures and anomalous behaviour.

  • Experience reproducing public benchmark results and finding where the original methodology is fragile or misleading.

  • An MSc or PhD in machine learning, computer science, cognitive science, computational neuroscience, physics, or a related quantitative field.

  • AI safety fellowship (MATS, ASTRA, Anthropic Fellows, etc.), or a comparable self-directed research record.

Why White Circle

  • Paid time off in line with your local regulations, no matter where you work from

  • Work from Paris (hybrid) with a relocation package available, or work from London (note: we are unable to provide relocation support or medical insurance for London-based roles)

  • Meaningful equity package

  • All the hardware, tools, and services you need

  • Covered subscriptions for AI agents and IDEs

  • Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps and to Saint-Tropez

How we hire

  1. Introductory call with HR (25 min)

  2. Take-home test task

  3. Technical interview with Head of Fundamental Research (60 min)

  4. Final conversation with our CEO (45 min)

jobs.title: Engineering Manager Embedded
jobs.description:
Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars.

Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor.

Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence.

If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk.

Please Note: Tell us about a physical product you helped ship - what your team built, what went wrong on the way to production, and what your part in fixing it was.


Your Responsibilities 🚀
  • Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management
  • Own delivery: quarterly planning and OKRs with leadership, translating requests from our country organizations into scoped, estimated engineering work, and saying no with a rationale when needed
  • Own the firmware release train (dev, canary, production) for the charger fleet and be answerable for fleet-impacting incidents alongside our operations teams

Procurement at HOLY is far more than buying ingredients. You will own our sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing while continuously improving cost, quality, supplier performance, flexibility and speed.

This is a highly strategic leadership position reporting directly to our COO, Markus. You will work closely with Product Development, Supply Chain Planning, Operations, Finance and our founders to build supplier partnerships capable of supporting HOLY's ambitious growth journey toward becoming a global consumer brand.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional procurement leader. We are looking for an exceptional builder with outstanding commercial judgment who enjoys solving complex business problems and creating long-term competitive advantages.

If you combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy building things from scratch, this role is for you.

Responsibilities: 

Strategic procurement

  • Own HOLY's sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing

  • Drive structural COGS improvements through strategic sourcing, commercial excellence and value engineering

  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with HOLY's key suppliers
  • Develop suppliers across capacity, quality, innovation, flexibility and operational excellence
  • Ensure our suppliers scale alongside HOLY's ambitious growth plans

  • Strengthen our supplier ecosystem through selective onboarding of new partners and pragmatic multi-sourcing where it creates value
Supply Chain & Operational Excellence
  • Improve end-to-end supply chain performance by reducing lead times, increasing supplier responsiveness and improving planning reliability
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning and Operations to align supplier capabilities with demand forecasts, inventory targets and growth plans
  • Improve working capital through stronger commercial terms, better supplier collaboration and optimized replenishment models
  • Support the development of a scalable and resilient manufacturing network
Supplier Performance & Quality
  • Own supplier performance across quality, OTIF, responsiveness, compliance and continuous improvement
  • Establish structured Supplier Business Reviews, measurable KPIs and clear accountability with strategic suppliers
  • Proactively identify and mitigate supply risks before they impact the business
  • Ensure suppliers consistently meet HOLY's quality, food safety and regulatory standards
Leadership & Organization Building
  • Lead and develop HOLY's Strategic Procurement and Operational Buying teams
  • Build a high-performance organization with strong commercial capabilities, clear ownership and a continuous improvement mindset
  • Develop future leaders and continuously raise the maturity of HOLY's procurement function
  • Build scalable processes, systems and ways of working that support HOLY's growth


About You

We care more about your ability to solve complex business problems than about having followed a traditional career path.

You might come from Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy Consulting, Commercial or another highly analytical business function.

Ideally, you bring several of the following experience & expertise:

  • 5–10+ years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Consulting, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial or another analytical leadership role
  • Outstanding structured problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex challenges into pragmatic solutions
  • Strong track record of leading and developing teams 
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth or entrepreneurial environments where ownership and speed matter
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience negotiating with suppliers, partners or senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and deliver measurable business impact
  • Experience building scalable processes, organizations and ways of working
  • Exposure to manufacturing, FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods is beneficial but not required
  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus but not required) 
Mindset & Qualities: 
  • You are a builder who enjoys creating structures, teams and processes from scratch
  • You combine strategic thinking with strong execution skills and are comfortable getting hands-on
  • You have exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities and can quickly structure complex situations
  • You take ownership, move fast and thrive in environments with high autonomy and ambiguity
  • You build trust easily and can influence suppliers, stakeholders and teams through strong communication and judgment
  • You are commercially minded and always look for ways to create measurable business impact


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over 2.5 million customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
  • How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: A 30-minute introductory conversation with Lutza, our Talent Acquisition Lead to get to know each other and discuss your experience, motivation and the role.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deep-dive discussion with Markus, our COO about your experience, leadership style and how you approach complex business challenges.
  3. Case Study: You will receive a business case to demonstrate your strategic thinking, analytical approach and ability to solve real HOLY challenges.
  4. Advanced Discussion in our office, the HOLY Temple: Present and discuss your case with key stakeholders while getting to know our team and our way of working.

Typically, this process takes around 2–3 weeks.

Dafür suchen wir einen Director Product (m/w/d), der die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Produktorganisation übernimmt und unsere Bereiche Product Development, Merchandising und Footwear Design führt.

Du steuerst nicht nur Produkte.

Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Trends, Ideen und Forecasts erfolgreiche Produkte werden, die zur richtigen Zeit, in der richtigen Menge, zur richtigen Qualität und zu wirtschaftlich starken Konditionen verfügbar sind.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Gesamtverantwortung für die Bereiche Product Development, Merchandising und Footwear Design
  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung der jeweiligen Heads und Senior Specialists sowie Weiterentwicklung der gesamten Product Organisation
  • Steuerung des kompletten Produktprozesses von Trend und Idee über Design, Sourcing, Sampling, Kalkulation und Produktion bis zur finalen Ware
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines starken internationalen Lieferanten- und Fabriknetzwerks mit klarem Schwerpunkt China
  • Direkte Steuerung und Verhandlung mit Fabriken zu Preisen, MOQ, Qualität, Kapazitäten, Lieferzeiten und Produktionsbedingungen
  • Konsequentes Troubleshooting bei Produktions-, Qualitäts- oder Lieferproblemen und persönliche Eskalation vor Ort, wenn es notwendig ist
  • Regelmäßige Reisen nach China und zu weiteren Produktionsstandorten, um Fabriken, Lieferanten und Produktionsprozesse persönlich zu steuern
  • Verantwortung für Produktqualität, Timelines, Margen, Costing und Lieferfähigkeit
  • Steuerung von Sortiment, Kollektionen und Produkt-Roadmaps gemeinsam mit Merchandising, Design, Marketing und Geschäftsführung
  • Analyse von Abverkauf, Nachfrage, Markttrends, Wettbewerbern und Customer Insights zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung des Produktportfolios
  • Aufbau klarer Prozesse, KPIs und Verantwortlichkeiten entlang des gesamten Product Lifecycles
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Supply Chain, Logistics, Marketing, Finance und Geschäftsführung
  • Frühzeitige Identifikation von Risiken und konsequentes Gegensteuern, bevor aus kleinen Problemen große werden


Dein Profil

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in einer führenden Rolle im Bereich Product, Product Development, Sourcing oder Footwear, idealerweise in einer stark wachsenden Consumer-, Fashion- oder Footwear Brand
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von Führungskräften und multidisziplinären Product Teams
  • Tiefgreifende China-Erfahrung und belastbares Netzwerk zu Fabriken, Produzenten und Lieferanten
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse chinesischer Produktionsprozesse, Mentalitäten, Verhandlungsstrukturen und Lieferantenbeziehungen
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Sourcing, Sampling, Quality Control, Costing, Produktionsplanung und Supplier Management
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Footwear Development, Materialien, Konstruktion, Passform und Qualitätsanforderungen
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Marge, Einkaufspreise, MOQ, Volumen und Produktprofitabilität
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer Produkt- und Produktionsprozesse in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Sehr hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft, insbesondere nach China
  • Du bist bereit, auch kurzfristig zu reisen, wenn ein kritisches Produktions- oder Lieferproblem vor Ort gelöst werden muss
  • Ausgeprägte Entscheidungsstärke, hohe Belastbarkeit und echte Hands-on-Mentalität
  • Du wartest nicht auf perfekte Informationen, sondern kannst unter Zeitdruck fundierte Entscheidungen treffen
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung bis zum Ergebnis und akzeptierst kein „geht nicht“, bevor wirklich alle Optionen geprüft wurden
  • Starkes Verhandlungsgeschick und die Fähigkeit, langfristige Lieferantenbeziehungen aufzubauen und gleichzeitig klare Erwartungen durchzusetzen
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere für die Zusammenarbeit mit asiatischen Lieferanten relevante Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Gesamtverantwortung: Du führst einen der zentralsten Bereiche unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase
  • Direkter Impact: Deine Entscheidungen wirken unmittelbar auf Sortiment, Marge, Qualität und Lieferfähigkeit
  • Internationaler Scope: Arbeite direkt mit Fabriken, Produzenten und Partnern in China und weiteren Produktionsmärkten
  • Leadership: Führe Product Development, Merchandising und Footwear Design als gemeinsame starke Organisation
  • Ownership: Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung und echte Verantwortung
  • Wachstum: Gestalte die Produktorganisation einer Footwear Brand mit über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden aktiv weiter

jobs.title: CMO - Chief Marketing Officer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du verantwortest das gesamte Marketing als Wachstumsmotor des Unternehmens – mit voller Budget- und Ergebnisverantwortung, direktem Draht zu den beiden Gründern und der Führung eines Teams von über 50 Menschen. Eine Rolle in dieser Größenordnung ist kein Ort zum Lernen: Wir suchen jemanden, der das alles schon einmal gemacht hat – und es jetzt größer machen will.
Performance Marketing. Du steuerst eines der größten Paid-Social-Setups im deutschen D2C – über 4 Millionen Euro Spend pro Monat auf Meta, TikTok und weiteren Kanälen – und skalierst es profitabel weiter. Deine Steuerungsgrößen sind Deckungsbeitrag und Neukunden-Ökonomie, nicht Klicks. Du entscheidest täglich auf Zahlenbasis, wo Budget hingeht und wo es rausgeht.
Influencer & Creator. Du führst und skalierst unser Influencer-Geschäft – eines der größten im Land, mit eigenem Team, klarer Erfolgsmessung pro Kooperation und Creator-Content als Treibstoff für Paid. Hier entsteht ein Großteil unseres Wachstums, und du machst daraus ein noch schärferes System.
Creative Engine. Du verantwortest unsere Content- und Creative-Produktion: hohe Schlagzahl, systematisches Testing, klare Erfolgsmuster. Du weißt, dass im D2C das Creative der größte Hebel im Account ist – und baust die Struktur, die jede Woche neue Gewinner liefert.
Internationalisierung. Du bringst unser Marketing-Playbook in neue Märkte – von der Lokalisierung der Creatives über den Aufbau lokaler Creator-Netzwerke bis zur profitablen Skalierung vor Ort. Gemeinsam mit unserem COO, der die operative Seite verantwortet.
Retention & Brand. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Käufern Wiederkäufer werden – CRM, E-Mail, Community – und entwickelst unsere Marke weiter, ohne dass sie ihre Herkunft verliert: nahbar, ehrlich, für Menschen, die den ganzen Tag auf den Beinen sind.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in führenden Marketing-Rollen im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld – mit voller Verantwortung für Budget und Ergebnis
  • Du hast schon mal Ad-Budgets in siebenstelliger Monatshöhe profitabel gesteuert und skaliert – und kannst erklären, wie: Struktur, Creative-Strategie, Messlogik
  • Du verstehst Influencer-Marketing als messbares Performance-Instrument, nicht als Reichweiten-Deko
  • Ausgeprägtes Creative-Urteilsvermögen: Du erkennst in drei Sekunden, ob ein Ad funktioniert – und kannst begründen, warum
  • Du steuerst über Deckungsbeitrag, CAC und Wiederkaufrate und entscheidest auf Basis von Zahlen
  • Führungserfahrung mit Organisationen von 50+ Menschen über mehrere Teams hinweg – und die Fähigkeit, Top-Leute anzuziehen und zu halten
  • Du bist Operator, kein Verwalter: Du gehst selbst ins Ad-Konto, in die Creatives, in die Daten
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch


Dein Profil

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der profitablen Steuerung und Skalierung siebenstelliger monatlicher Paid-Media-Budgets
  • Tiefes Verständnis von Performance Marketing, Creative Strategy, Influencer Marketing und Retention als integrierte Wachstumstreiber
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Deckungsbeitrag, CAC, Neukunden-Ökonomie und Wiederkaufrate
  • Erfahrung in der Führung größerer, multidisziplinärer Marketing-Organisationen mit mehreren Teams und Führungskräften
  • Ausgeprägtes Creative- und Performance-Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Daten, Creatives und Kampagnen selbst operativ zu challengen
  • Erfahrung in der Internationalisierung und Skalierung von Marketing-Playbooks in neue Märkte
  • Hoher unternehmerischer Drive, starke Entscheidungsfähigkeit und ein klarer Operator-Mindset sowie verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Die Führung einer Marketing-Maschine, die bereits bewiesen hat, dass sie skaliert – du baust auf Stärke, nicht auf Hoffnung
  • Volle Ownership über Budget, Teams und Roadmap – Entscheidungen fallen in Stunden, nicht in Gremien
  • Direkter Zugang zu den Gründern, die Marketing selbst aufgebaut haben und wissen, was gute Arbeit ist
  • Ein Vergütungspaket, das der Rolle gerecht wird, inklusive leistungsabhängiger Komponenten
  • Offices in Hamburg und der Region Kiel 
  • Ein Team, das Tempo liebt und Erfolge feiert

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
📍 London Office (Aldgate East, E1) | Hybrid - 3 days in the office, 2 days remote (or office if you prefer!)

The opportunity

Goodlord is on a mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re searching for an Enterprise Account Executive reporting directly to our Head of Sales to help us achieve it!

As we accelerate our strategic growth, you will step into a high-impact, pioneer role dedicated to our Enterprise segment (agents managing 1,500+ properties).

Joining an emerging enterprise function backed by dedicated ABM and SDR support, you will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, position value to C-level executives, and help build and scale our Enterprise Go-To-Market playbook.

In this role you'll:

  • Build and execute strategic account plans for high-value enterprise accounts, partnering with dedicated ABM and SDR resources to drive multi-threaded C-suite outreach.

  • Lead rigorous discovery sessions using MEDDPICC to map complex organisational structures, diagnose operational risks, and present tailored ROI business cases.

  • Manage complex enterprise sales motions from initial engagement through legal, info-sec, procurement, and final sign-off for multi-year contracts.

  • Act as a core builder alongside early enterprise leadership to refine, standardise, and scale our Enterprise GTM playbook, templates, and collateral.

What we need from you:

  • Proven track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B SaaS deals, typically £50k+ ARR and/or multi-year contracts, across longer Enterprise sales cycles (often 6–12 months).

  • Hands-on MEDDPICC experience to navigate complex deal cycles and maintain accurate CRM forecasting.

  • Experience multi-threading complex buying committees across C-suite, Operations, Finance, IT/Security, Legal and Procurement.

  • A demonstrable track record of value-led selling – moving customer conversations beyond features and price to build compelling commercial and ROI cases.

  • A builder mindset with comfort operating in scale-up environments where GTM processes are actively being co-created.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience selling SaaS into PropTech, Real Estate, Property Management, FinTech or another regulated/operationally complex environment.

  • An executive-level network across major UK letting agency groups, franchise networks, or corporate property managers.

  • Experience as an early hire in an emerging enterprise team, helping build sales collateral, objection-handling guides, and GTM strategy from scratch.

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.
